parameters.query:
SELECT lc.id as cat_id, lc.category, lc.category_group, lc.category_group_tr , bl.* 
FROM lead_db.business_leads bl
LEFT JOIN lead_db.lead_category lc ON bl.category = lc.category
LEFT JOIN lead_db.cold_reach_leads crl ON crl.cid = bl.cid
WHERE bl.pipelined IS NULL OR bl.pipelined = 0 and crl.pipelined = 0 or bl.pipelined IS NULL 
LIMIT 50;

SET 
    pipelined = 3,  -- 3: E-posta Yok/Geçersiz (veya sizin belirleyeceğiniz bir durum kodu)
    mailing_platform = 'no_valid_email_found',
